name: Do I need a permit to install a threshold ramp in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to install a threshold ramp in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most standard residential threshold ramp installations that don't involve structural changes to the building or significant exterior modifications, a permit is typically not required. However, if the ramp is part of a larger renovation project, involves extensive construction, or is for a commercial property, permits might be necessary. We advise checking with your specific local city building department, such as in Pacifica or San Mateo, or we can assist in determining if a permit is needed for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Generally, permits are not needed for standard residential threshold ramps, but may be required for extensive construction or commercial properties. Consult local city building departments.
